name: picom
description_en: A lightweight compositor for X11 with animation support
readme_excerpt: picom picom is a compositor for X, and a fork of Compton. This is a development branch, bugs to be expected You can leave your feedback or thoughts in the discussion tab, or chat with other users on discord!
